overview: Built an automated recruitment and candidate screening system for managing job applications from initial submission to interview scheduling.

The workflow takes a new candidate application and turns it into a structured candidate record, including resume processing, AI analysis, job matching, scoring, screening, interview preparation, notifications, and final recruitment status management.

list: Receives new candidate applications through a webhook
Checks whether the selected job position is currently open
Searches existing candidate records to prevent duplicates
Creates and organizes candidate folders in Google Drive
Uploads and stores candidate resumes automatically
Extracts structured information from each resume
Analyzes experience, education, skills, projects, and qualifications using AI
Compares candidate profiles against job requirements
Calculates a weighted candidate matching score
Routes candidates based on high, medium, or low screening scores
Creates shortlisted candidate records automatically
Generates personalized interview questions based on the resume and job role
Creates an HR interview brief with strengths, concerns, and recommended focus areas
Sends shortlisted candidate notifications to the HR team through Slack
Sends interview invitations automatically through Gmail
Creates interview events and meeting details in Google Calendar
Updates candidate status after interview scheduling
Sends medium scoring candidates for manual HR review
Organizes non shortlisted candidates separately for further review

blocks.p: The workflow uses predefined screening, interview, and communication templates throughout the recruitment process.

list: Candidate evaluation criteria
Job matching requirements
Interview questions
HR screening summaries
Email communication

blocks.p: This keeps candidate evaluations consistent while allowing every application to be processed according to the selected job role.
Airtable acts as the central recruitment database and tracking system.
Each processed candidate is updated with:

list: Resume URL
AI analysis
Candidate score
Job match status
Interview status

result: A complete automated recruitment pipeline that turns a candidate application into a screened, scored, organized, and interview ready candidate profile without requiring HR teams to manually process every resume. The system also keeps candidate records, resumes, screening results, interview details, and recruitment status organized in one workflow.
